final: WITH major_shares AS (SELECT mj.major_id, mj.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share FROM member AS m JOIN major AS mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY mj.major_id, mj.department), compared AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS difference_above_department_average FROM major_shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, difference_above_department_average FROM compared WHERE difference_above_department_average > 0 ORDER BY difference_above_department_average IS NULL, difference_above_department_average DESC LIMIT 10
